sarasutta: [ sara + sutta ] (na) CL=7  The discourse teaches that a celestial being asks: “From which place does the lake of saṃsāra cease or run out? In which place does cyclic suffering not occur? In which place are both consciousness and form completely ceased?” The Buddha replies: In the state of Nibbāna, the elements of cohesion (Āpodhātu) and motion (vāyodhātu) cannot be established.
